body:
Thank you, @mig-builds, for this fix and for the clear validation steps.

Both this PR and #25367 state the post-#25275 `has()` rule correctly. The maintainer chose to land #25367 (ruling `6358845679` on #25282, letter A), because it also gives the exact reason such a path gets no guard: a step-at-a-time guard would end one `has()` on the index, and `has()` refuses an index as its last step. This repository lands contributions through an internal branch (card-first), so I'm closing this one in favour of #25367. Its landing commit carries `Co-authored-by: mig-builds <54319294+mig-builds@users.noreply.github.com>` to credit your work.

Thanks again. Contributions like this are very welcome.
